name: Camp Mendocino Leaders-in-Training (LIT) and Careers-in-Training (CIT)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (Camp Mendocino)
city: San Francisco, CA (overnight camp at Camp Mendocino; buses leave from San Francisco)
what_you_do: LITs help younger campers, take job skills classes and shadow staff at an overnight camp. CITs pick a track: youth work, upkeep or the kitchen. They learn job skills and earn a certificate.
who_can_apply: LIT: ages 15 to 17. CIT: ages 16 to 17 who already did LIT (in person or virtually). CITs must commit to two sessions, one of them a 7-day session. No city or residency rule is stated.
pay_detail: Free: the camp fee is waived for all sessions for accepted LITs and CITs. Not a paid job.
duration: In 2026, LIT/CIT training was June 17 to 20, then camp sessions ran June 20 to Aug 5. LITs can do one or more sessions; CITs do two.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 15, with rolling deadlines Feb 16, March 16, April 13 and a final deadline of May 4, 2026. The camp says 'See you in 2027,' but 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the LIT/CIT online application on the Teen Leadership page. Then register for camp and pick the 'CIT/LIT programs' price option, which waives the fee once you are accepted. Training is at camp in Session 1A, or a required virtual training.
notes: Apply early. The FAQ says spots often fill by early April. The camp told teens in rounds. For example, it replied by March 2 for the Feb 16 deadline. Buses leave from San Francisco. For Session 1, there is also a stop near Travis Air Force Base. Teens who are 15 can sign up as regular campers instead. People 18 and up can apply for camp staff jobs. Contact: camperapplication@kidsclub.org.
